findings.title: [P1] Preserve argument-vector execution for branch names
findings.body: When `branch` contains shell metacharacters (for example, `main; <command>`), `exec` passes the interpolated string through a shell and executes the appended command with the Node process's privileges. The previous `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` treated the value only as a Git argument, so retain argument-vector execution rather than constructing a shell command.
